title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 23: A Decision

scenes.say: A juvenile detention yard. Boys in orange jumpsuits.
scenes.visual: teenage boys in orange jumpsuits in a rec yard, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Y'all remind me of me. What saved me wasn't the Army. It was a decision.
scenes.visual: a man speaking to boys in a fenced yard, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: One boy locks in. I wanna choose too.
scenes.visual: a boy in orange looking up, light on the fence, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The old corner where he once sold drugs. Same stoop. Same faces.
scenes.visual: a Newark stoop at dusk, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Now the kids greet him. That's the soldier guy!
scenes.visual: kids waving on a sidewalk at dusk, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Legacy ain't what you leave. It's who you lift.
scenes.visual: a man tipping his hat walking down a street, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: His father's grave. He places a photo of himself in uniform.
scenes.visual: a photo of a soldier placed on a grave, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I used to hate you for not being there. Now I just hope I did better.
scenes.visual: a man standing at a grave, then walking away lighter, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: If you could tell your seventeen year old self one thing: You ain't a mistake. You just ain't been molded yet.
scenes.visual: a man sitting in front of a black backdrop, silhouette, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Twenty Four. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a sunrise over a cemetery, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 23 of 25: A Decision. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
